Disney Believe to Debut World’s First Encanto Musical, All-New Frozen Family Feast, and More in December 2027

The ship will offer four- and five-night sailings from south Florida to the Caribbean and The Bahamas, making stops at one or both of Disney Cruise Line’s island destinations—Disney Castaway Cay and Disney Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point.
